answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake bond before it can transact, locked for a full epoch and slashed on proven fraud. A sybil farm then faces real cost per identity: a thousand fake agents need a thousand bonds, while honest agents earn theirs back from fees. Reputation accretes like a pearl, layer by layer, and cannot be faked overnight. A dune of cheap identities washes away at dawn when the bond check runs, because only bonded agents keep their history and escrow access.
